description: Hiring Intel, the same search as app.fundz.net/hiring-intel: companies hiring right now from their live job postings, each with open-role counts, sample roles, hiring signals (exec backfill, vacancy aging, role reposted, key role posted, department expansion, hiring surge, tech stack), an intent score and why, recent funding and leadership change. view "companies" (default) returns one card per company; view "postings" returns individual open job postings with links. Filter by industry, location, country, company size, keyword, department, technology, remote, days open, signals, recent funding or leadership change. Page through every match with page; use since to get only postings Fundz first saw on or after a date. To find companies hiring a leadership role, USE title_family (for example title_family "sales_leadership" for "hiring a VP Sales, Head of Sales, Sales Director or CRO"), never a single keyword: titles vary ("VP Sales" returns nothing at a company that posts "Director of Sales"). keyword also takes several titles joined with " OR " or "|". department "Sales" also covers Go-to-market, GTM, Revenue and Business Development.

days.description: Only postings Fundz first saw in the last N days (default 45, max 120)

department.description: Department, e.g. "Engineering", "Finance". "Sales" also matches Go-to-market, GTM, Revenue, Commercial and Business Development.

employees_min.description: Companies view: minimum employee count. Companies with no headcount on file are kept and marked "headcount unknown", ranked after the known in-range ones.

funded_within_days.description: Companies view: only companies with a funding round in the last N days

has_first_degree.description: Companies view: only companies where the user has 1st-degree LinkedIn connections (needs their network uploaded)

has_hiring_manager.description: Companies view: only companies with a named hiring manager on a posting (a narrow filter)

icp_match_only.description: Companies view: only companies matching the user's targeting profile

industry.description: Companies view: industry title(s), comma-separated, e.g. "Health Care, Financial Services"

keyword.description: Matched against job titles, e.g. "controller". Several titles: "Director of Sales OR Head of Sales". For a role family prefer title_family.

limit.description: Results per page (companies view default 10, postings default 20, max 50)

location.description: Companies view: city, state or region title(s), separated by semicolons, e.g. "Texas; Austin, Texas"

min_days_open.description: Only postings open at least this many days (hard-to-fill roles), e.g. 60

my_territory.description: Companies view: only companies inside the locations of the user's saved filters

new_since_last_pull.description: Postings view: only postings this account has not already been shown by an earlier new_since_last_pull call with the same filters. Fundz remembers per account and filter set, so a daily agent run gets just what is new, with no dates to track. The first call returns the normal window (days or since) and starts the marker. Ignores page: if more new rows are waiting the reply says so; call again the same way for the next batch. Needs a signed-in account.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). The reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

recent_exec_change.description: Companies view: only companies with a leadership change in the last 30 days

signals.description: Companies view: only companies with one of these signals in the last 14 days, comma-separated: exec_backfill, vacancy_aging, role_reposted, key_role_posted, department_expansion, hiring_surge, tech_stack_signal

since.description: Only postings Fundz first saw on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01". Overrides days; reaches back at most 120 days.

tech.description: Technology named in the postings, e.g. "Salesforce", "Snowflake"

title_family.description: Title family: one OR set of roles, comma-separated for several. sales_leadership = VP / Vice President / Head of / Director of Sales, Revenue or GTM, plus CRO and Chief Revenue Officer. sales_manager = Sales Manager titles (add it when the user says "sales leaders and managers"). marketing_leadership, engineering_leadership, finance_leadership.

view.description: "companies" (default): one card per hiring company. "postings": individual open job postings.

name: search_hiring_intel
title: Search Hiring Intel
